ana.pm: Kickoff: we need a compact pilot sourcing + handoff playbook for a 10-customer private beta that emphasizes realistic production traffic and quick remediation loops. Thoughts on outreach messaging and selection?
noah.eng: Agree. We should explicitly ask for a "primary eng contact" and expected peak QPS + typical seq length in the outreach form. that data drives infra prioritization.
riyah.se: For incentives, let's offer a pilot-only discounted rate + 2 proactive performance tuning sessions. Also propose a 2-week "warmup" window so we can validate traffic without SLAs first.
tomas.soleng: On handoff: solutions engineering will provide a preconfigured terraform snippet and a one-line runbook for common network setups. we should standardize the onboarding smoke test too.
zia.legal: We'll prepare a short pilot addendum: term, data handling, and a rollback clause. non-negotiable: no customer data leaves their VPC; our agent only submits minimal logs unless customer opts-in.
nana.pm (typo correction): sorry meant ana.pm :)
nana.pm (fix): moving on — propose outreach lanes: A) strategic infra tests (heavy QPS, long seqs) B) feature validation (cost/quality tradeoffs) C) compliance & security (private-only, on-prem). each lane gets tailored checklist.
pilot-bot: Created Pilot Intake Form: https://forms.redwood.ai/private-pilot-intake (by pilot-bot)
nana.pm: Suggested selection rubric (weighted):
- business impact (1-5) weight 30%
- expected peak QPS weight 25%
- avg seq length weight 15%
- infra complexity (low/med/high) weight 10%
- availability of eng contact (yes/no) weight 10%
- legal/regulatory fit weight 10%
score threshold: top 12 candidates -> shortlist 10 -> final 10.
noah.eng: Add a technical quick-score for whether they can run the terraform snippet (yes=pass, no=manual assist). prefer at least 6/10 with pass for automation validity.
riyah.se: Outreach DM template (short):
"Hey <name> — we're running a short private pilot to validate our private deployment flow (on-prem/VPC). We think you'd be a great fit given <reason>. Pilot includes 3 months free support credit + tuning sessions. Interested? Quick intake form: <link>"
nana.pm: Nice. also prepare a longer email for procurement/stakeholders with contractual highlights and expected timelines.
tomas.soleng: Onboarding smoke checklist (to be automated):
```
- terraform apply sample-setup
- confirm KMS alias exists
- run sample inference: curl -X POST https://<customer-endpoint>/v1/infer -d '{"input":"ping"}'
- verify telemetry: see metrics in console (kv_cache_hits > 0 after repeated calls)
- validate fallback: toggle canary -> ensure request still completes
```
riyah.se: Feedback cadence proposal:
- Day 1: setup confirmation + 3-min quick survey
- Week 1: onboarding call (30m)
- Weeks 2-6: weekly office hours + automated perf eval every 48h
- End of pilot: deep-dive NPS + product/infra readout
ana.pm: Success gates (candidate level):
- Setup: customer completes full setup < 7 business days
- Usage: >5000 inference tokens/day for at least 3 distinct days during stabilization window
- Stability: no more than 3 critical incidents (downtime or total failure) in pilot window
- Quality: automated evals show <5% regression on baseline prompts
noah.eng: Ops gating: if we see repeated tail latencies >1s for seq_len>1024, trigger mitigation plan (throttle, routing, or model fallback). log these events for postmortem.
zia.legal: I'll attach the pilot addendum template to the packet. also need a short opt-in checkbox for telemetry collection in the intake form.
tomas.soleng: Deliverables for next week:
- solutions-eng: terraform snippet + runbook (ETA 4d)
- eng: onboarding automation + telemetry dashboard (ETA 8d)
- product: outreach copy + scoring sheet (ETA 2d)
- legal: pilot addendum draft (ETA 3d)
nana.pm: I'll assemble the pilot packet and a 7-slide onboarding deck + a 5-min screencast. who wants to co-record?
riyah.se: I can host the live demo and capture common gotchas.
pilot-bot: Scheduled follow-up: Friday 10:00 to review outreach list and scoring (invites sent).
nana.pm: small risk log: 1) customers overcommitting traffic early -> mitigation: ramp plan + agreed warmup; 2) unclear rollback expectations -> mitigation: handshake doc; 3) billing mismatch -> mitigation: billing dry-run with finance.
noah.eng: one final ask: include a short field in intake for "preferred datacenter/region" so we can spread pilot load.
nana.pm: great. thanks everyone. we'll reconvene Friday. :rocket:
